results.title: The New York Times Op-Docs acquires ‘The Revolution Against Death’
results.description: The New York Times Op-Docs has acquired the documentary short film “The Revolution Against Death” by acclaimed filmmaker Joshua Oppenheimer. The film, which premiered at the Tampere Film Festival and recently screened at the Telluride Film Festival, will be coreleased with MUBI globally.
